items.text: Eagles play first game without Jalen Hurts (calf/superficial blood clot); Tanner McKee starts.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade; McKee low ceiling but top pass-catchers healthy.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks in McKee offense.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for Sunday vs. Panthers; second straight miss. Will Shipley also out/IR.
items.why: Hamstring; no practice Fri; official ruling.
items.implication: Eagles backfield to Dameon Pierce lead with limited upside behind Tanner McKee; pass-catchers elevated.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps/carries/goal-line to Pierce; DeVonta Smith/Goedert/Wicks targets rise.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson (ankle) for Sunday at CLE; no practice all week, Huntley starts again.
items.implication: Huntley starts second straight; Ravens offense more limited but still productive historically.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers/Mark Andrews retain volume but lower ceiling without Lamar mobility/scoring.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday Q add. Many Qs (Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle) seem more probable. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so 2-WR sets Metcalf+Bernard. PHI McKee has 4th-string RB but top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) healthy.
items.why: Practice trends and designations; PHI/PIT depth notes.
items.implication: Favor probable Qs; fade uncertain ankles; stack PHI pass-catchers; Metcalf volume up.
items.opportunity: Route/target concentration for listed healthy pass-catchers; Metcalf snaps.

items.text: Rashee Rice listed OUT (with Tyquan Thornton) in ETR Sunday injury roundup.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and other KC WRs/TE see route/target share bump.

items.text: David Montgomery listed OUT in ETR comprehensive Sunday injuries.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining HOU backs.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed IN (cleared) alongside CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty in ETR roundup; returns with Hurts/Saquon out.
items.why: Removed from report after hamstring/toe; full participant.
items.implication: Key return for McKee-led Eagles; Lamb/Jeanty also clear.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets for Smith; Jeanty full RB role.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren added as questionable Friday (groin) after injury in individual drills.
items.why: Groin; Friday addition, limited visibility post-injury.
items.implication: Monitor Sunday; potential TE downgrade if limited/out.
items.opportunity: If out, other IND TEs/WRs gain targets.

items.text: AJ Brown questionable (ankle) on Patriots final injury report.
items.implication: Game-time; if out, NE WR/RB roles shift (Henderson also Q ankle).
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated snaps for other NE skill players.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation (cleared/IN) for Sunday at KC; other Chargers outs include Tre Harris.
items.implication: Full role expected; positive for LAC passing game.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) vs Rams; resting for long-term healing.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining ARI RBs.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR AD Mitchell again for Sunday vs Patriots.
items.implication: Jets RB committee elevated; limited offense overall.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans (WR4 vs WSH), Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH) for soft Commanders matchups and bankable usage; also Kyren Williams (RB5), Javonte Williams (RB8), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9) for volume vs leaky run Ds.
items.why: WSH D buffet for pass-catchers; elite recent usage/goal-line for RBs; soft run matchups.
items.implication: Start with confidence in favorable spots.
items.opportunity: High target/route share expected; RB carries + RZ.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (TE18), J.K. Dobbins (RB27 vs SEA), Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA), Justin Herbert (QB25 @ KC) due to tough matchups, shaky QB play, and low scoring environments.
items.why: Ugly matchups (SEA pass/run D), low team totals, inconsistent feeding.
